subject.title: fix: stabilize OpenClaw beta setup and PT-PT formatting

question: Should this PR wait for an official OpenClaw artifact containing the `wizard.start installDaemon=false` contract, or should maintainers select a different setup-proven release target?
rationale: The successful setup run used a custom paired package, while the checked-in default points to an official beta that has not been proven to include the required protocol behavior.

options.title: Wait and pin shipped contract
options.body: Keep the PR draft until the upstream contract ships, then pin that exact artifact and rerun official-package setup E2E.

options.title: Choose another proven release
options.body: Select a different official OpenClaw release only if it passes the complete Companion-owned setup path without a local protocol patch.

recommendation.title: Wait and pin shipped contract
recommendation.body: Keep the PR draft until the upstream contract ships, then pin that exact artifact and rerun official-package setup E2E.

likelyOwner.reason: The available repository evidence connects him to the Windows companion and its setup ownership, though file-level history is ambiguous.
